# RuLit.me

> > Digital library providing free online access to Russian-language books, educational materials, and pedagogical resources.

RuLit.me specializes in educational literature, particularly early childhood education materials by authors like Valentina Gerbova. The site offers full-text reading of books with page-by-page navigation, focusing on speech development, kindergarten curricula, and teaching methodologies.

## Key Topics

- Гербова Валентина Викторовна (Valentina Gerbova)
- Развитие речи (Speech Development)
- Детский сад (Kindergarten)
- Младшая группа (Younger age groups)
- Планы занятий (Lesson plans)
- Диалогическая речь (Dialogic speech)
- Сюжетные картины (Story pictures)
- Игры-инсценировки (Role-play games)
- Методика обучения (Teaching methodology)
- Мозаика-Синтез (Mozaika-Sintez publisher)
- Наглядно-дидактическое пособие (Visual-didactic materials)
- Раннее детство (Early childhood)
- Педагогика (Pedagogy)

## Speech Development Resources

- [Занятия по развитию речи в первой младшей группе детского сада - Страница 40](https://rulit.me/books/zanyatiya-po-razvitiyu-rechi-v-pervoj-mladshej-gruppe-detskogo-sada-plany-zanyatij-read-314460-40.html): Page 40 of Gerbova's comprehensive guide to speech development lessons for first younger kindergarten groups, including detailed lesson plans and methodological approaches
